name: Maritime
long_description: Maritime is cloud infrastructure for AI agents. We help companies give every customer an agent running in its own isolated, persistent computer, starting at $1 per agent per month. Maritime handles hosting, scaling, and sleep/wake automatically, so developers can run thousands of agents without managing the infrastructure.

launches.title: Maritime: Fully managed cloud for running AI agents at scale
launches.tagline: Run millions of agents, each on its own isolated, persistent VM.
launches.body:
Hi everyone, we’re Maria and Ary, founders of [Maritime](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/38061) (YC F26).

**TL;DR:** Maritime is a fully managed cloud platform for running millions of AI agents, each on its own isolated, persistent VM.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TnGXH9H0cTw>

**Why we built Maritime** 

We believe we’re heading toward a world with billions of AI agents. Everyone will have agents working for them, and businesses will run entire teams of AI employees. A new generation of startups will build and sell these agents, giving every customer one of their own.

We started working on Maritime when OpenClaw was released. Now, with dots, Instinct, Grok Bot, and Muse, that future is taking shape. We saw the infrastructure challenge firsthand while hosting hundreds of agents during our research at MIT. Even at that scale, our time went into getting environments running, maintaining them, and debugging individual agents.

Running billions of agents will require infrastructure that lets developers give each one a persistent computer and manage entire fleets with ease. We’re building Maritime to make that possible, so any startup can launch an agent product, give every customer their own agent, and scale it to millions in no time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=120824&key=user_uploads/3118952/6772cfd5-737c-4278-8a02-ec3793cb070b)

**What Maritime does**

Maritime gives every agent a persistent computer and manages the infrastructure around it:

* **An isolated VM for each agent.** Run code, install software, and use a browser.
* **Pricing built for scale.** Hosting starts at $1 per agent per month, making it practical to give every customer their own persistent computer and grow your fleet as your product grows.
* **Persistence between tasks.** Keep files, memory, installed software, and logins so agents can pick up where they left off.
* **Tools to manage individual agents.** Inspect, debug, and fix each customer’s agent directly.
* **Different environments for different workflows.** Choose Linux computers, Windows desktops, or virtual Android phones based on the software and apps your agents need.

You can run your agent code inside a Maritime VM, or keep your agent on your existing backend and use MCP to let it control a Maritime computer.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=120824&key=user_uploads/3118952/db071ab8-94f8-4245-9de8-f574cc2aba1d)

**Who it’s for**

Teams building and selling AI employees, personal assistants, and other products where every customer has an agent of their own.

We want founders to focus on building and growing their products, with Maritime managing the infrastructure to run them.

**Our ask**

* **Try Maritime:** Host three agents for free at [maritime.sh](http://maritime.sh). Hosting starts at $1 per agent per month.
* **Introduce us:** If you know teams building and selling agents, especially those deploying a separate agent or computer for every customer, please comment or connect us.
